What Laude Institute / Terminal-Bench does

  • Terminal-Bench: Open tests of agent work in command-line environments (text-based interfaces for running commands on computers). The reviewed homepage shows version 4.0.
  • Slingshots: Grants and hands-on support for research projects.
  • Moonshots: Support for research labs pursuing work over longer periods.
  • Harbor
